description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee license search results, extending a generic FilterParams class. It primarily manages the employee number and specifies sorting by license name.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee allowed license search results, including employee number filter and default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
